name: Lo-Ammi
title: Hosea's Symbolic Son
summary: Lo-Ammi was the third son of the prophet Hosea and his wife Gomer. His name means 'not my people' and served as a prophetic sign that God would temporarily reject Israel because of their unfaithfulness and idolatry.

keyEvents.title: The Birth and Naming of Lo-Ammi
keyEvents.description: God commanded Hosea to name the child Lo-Ammi as a prophetic sign. The name meant that Israel was no longer God's people because of their sin.

keyEvents.title: The Symbolic Meaning of the Name
keyEvents.description: The name Lo-Ammi represented God's judgment on Israel. Just as Gomer had been unfaithful to Hosea, Israel had been unfaithful to God through idolatry.

keyEvents.title: Promise of Restoration
keyEvents.description: Despite the judgment, the prophecy also included a promise of future restoration. Those who were called 'not my people' would again be called 'children of the living God'.

keyEvents.title: Paul Quotes Hosea's Prophecy
keyEvents.description: The apostle Paul used the prophecy about Lo-Ammi to explain how Gentiles were included in God's people through faith in Christ.

keyEvents.title: Peter applies the prophecy
keyEvents.description: The apostle Peter also applied Hosea's prophecy to Christians, showing how those who once were not a people had now become God's people.
